compiled_state.description:
fix-bug:investigation

ROOT_CAUSE: ticket-create.sh lines 154-163 use raw $parent_id (alias or any non-canonical form) directly in directory check [ ! -d $TRACKER_DIR/$parent_id ] without calling resolve_ticket_id. resolve_ticket_id is already in scope (sourced via ticket-lib.sh line 21). Alias strings are never directory names so the check always fails.

FIX_FILE: plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-create.sh
FIX_LOCATION: line 154, immediately after 'if [ -n "$parent_id" ]; then'
FIX_CHANGE: add 'if ! parent_id=$(TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR="$TRACKER_DIR" resolve_ticket_id "$parent_id"); then exit 1; fi' before the directory check — mirrors ticket-edit.sh line 145

RED_TEST_FILE: tests/scripts/test-ticket-create.sh
RED_TEST_NAME: test_alias_5 — parent alias resolution: create child with --parent <alias> succeeds and resolves to canonical parent_id
RED_TEST_STEPS: (1) create parent epic, read alias from CREATE event; (2) call ticket create task 'Child' --parent <alias>; (3) assert exit 0 and non-empty child ID; (4) assert child CREATE event parent_id == canonical parent ID

CONFIDENCE: HIGH (direct code inspection + cross-reference with ticket-edit.sh pattern)
COMPLEXITY: TRIVIAL
MANUAL_APPROVAL_NEEDED: false
